title: CI error in bolus calculations
symptom: During dinner, the user used the wizard to bolus and saw over 7U to be given, which is more than usual (less than 5U). The calculated CI (carbohydrate ratio) did not correspond to any profile setting, even 160% of profile CI. The user stopped the injection immediately. When using the wizard a second time, it worked correctly.
cause: The maintainer (MilosKozak) could not find a bug in the logs and suggested the only possible reason is that the user selected another profile for calculation in the dialog, possibly one with IC 4.3. However, the user checked and none of their profiles use a CI of 4.3, so the cause remains unresolved.
evidence_quote: The only possible reason I see is you selected another profile for calculation in dialog. Don't you have one with IC 4,3?
